macros.name: AutoTitle
macros.doc: If you want to add an extra title to the automatically generated dvd titles in Dvd, you can use \AutoTitle in the argument {⟨title⟩} and simply add your extra title.

macros.name: Description
macros.doc: You have to use \Description before \DvdTitleWithDescription (see: 4.2.2) to specify the {⟨description⟩}, which will be typeset into a pdf annotation.

macros.name: DvdCounter
macros.doc: \DvdCounter will provide the dvd counter with correct spacing, if you want to leave the process of automatic titles.

macros.name: DvdPart
macros.doc: You can split up your archives into different parts like tv series, documentaries and so on. You just have to use \DvdPart.

macros.name: DvdSpace
macros.doc: \DvdSpace can be used to get the same space, that is used within the process of automatic titling.

macros.name: DvdTitle
macros.doc: \DvdTitle is used to specify the respective titles ({⟨title⟩}) on your dvd (within environment Dvd). {⟨length⟩} is used to typeset the length (e.g. 43:12) and in general followed by the addition min.

macros.name: DvdTitleWithDescription
macros.doc: \DvdTitleWithDescription is equivalent to \DvdTitle apart from the fact, that {⟨title⟩} will have a link to a pdf annotation with a description of the recording.

macros.name: listofdvds
macros.doc: \listofdvds will provide a list of dvds with {⟨columns⟩} (default: 2) columns.

macros.name: listofdvds
macros.doc: \listofdvds will provide a list of dvds with {⟨columns⟩} (default: 2) columns.

macros.name: listofemptydescriptions
macros.doc: \listofemptydescriptions will create a list with all titles with an empty description.

macros.name: SetCounterSpace
macros.doc: \SetCounterSpace can be used to change the standard space used within the process of automatic titling, which is by default set to 0.7em.

macros.name: SetLFRName
macros.doc: If you are unhappy with the predefined LFR heading, you can use \SetLFRName to set your own.

macros.name: SetLFRSecNumwidth
macros.doc: \SetLFRSecNumwidth can be used to adjust the width of the box for the numbers in the LFR.

macros.name: SetSeason
macros.doc: With \SetSeason one can specify the position of a title within a series, e.g. 01x15.

macros.name: SetSeason
macros.doc: With \SetSeason one can specify the position of a title within a series, e.g. 01x15.

macros.name: SetTOCNumwidth
macros.doc: \SetTOCNumwidth can be used to adjust the width of the box in the TOC (Table of Contents) for the numbers of the parts and series.

macros.name: SetTOCSecIndent
macros.doc: With \SetTOCSecIndent you can set the indent of the entries for dvds in the TOC.

envs.name: Dvd
envs.doc: The environment Dvd is used to define the DVDs.
